description:
Stellar Networks

Information at your fingertips.

Stellar Networks is a quality-of-life oriented mod. It adds six new interactive intel boards: Contacts, Commodity, Exploration, Market Queries (space Google) and Viewer, and Storage. It is a continuation of my three separate 0.9.1a mods -

Stellar Logistics

,

Hyperspace Network

, and

Galactic Markets

.

Contacts

board presents a filterable (by priority, by type) list of all your active contacts. Using the board, you can quickly navigate to see each contact's intel details, or directly call the person. All items and ships acquired during the call will be deposited to the Storage of the respective market.

Images

[close]

Commodity

board (formerly

Galactic Markets

) is used to display buying and selling prices among all known markets. It also hosts a Profit tab which can be used to find viable trade routes. Profit tab filters by most profitable routes in descending order and displays routes where:

profit margin is at least 10000 credits, andtrade volume is at least 100 items.

It also highlights rows when buy and sell markets are in the same system and caps results to first 50.

The above defaults are all configurable in LunaLib settings.

Images

[close]

Exploration

mini-board is a small intel based filter tool to quickly show or hide selected intel found in %u201CExploration%u201D tab. Works on intel added by CaptainsLog (will show additional filters).

Market

query board (formerly

Hyperspace Network

) manages market searches. These can be either staff search (e.g. freelance administrator, steady officer, aggressive mercenary), item search (e.g. specific mod-spec or weapon), or ship search (e.g. pristine frigate, d-modded carrier).

Images

[close]Market Viewer board lets you select a market and preview content of all its legal submarkets.

Images

[close]

By default, both Market boards work with Open and Military Markets only. To enable support for Black or Custom Markets, change settings via LunaLib.

Storage

board (formerly

Stellar Logistics

) displays all cargo and ships stored among all Storages. It allows displaying a unified view to quickly check what is available, and per-location view to find out where.

Images

aiDescription: Adds six interactive intel boards for managing contacts, commodities, exploration data, market searches, market previews, and stored cargo. Each board provides filtering, sorting, and quick access to related game functions. The mod integrates with existing systems like CaptainsLog and LunaLib for extended functionality.

changelog.3.1.3: Updated for 0.98a. Fixed issue with market query board not showing results for certain search types. Added support for new ship types in ship search.
changelog.3.1.2: Fixed bug in Storage board where cargo was not updating correctly after transfers. Improved performance of Commodity board with large datasets.
changelog.3.1.1: Added new filter options to Exploration board. Fixed minor UI glitches in Market Viewer. Updated LunaLib dependency to 1.4.0.
